description: Client-side script for the 'Project' doctype in ERPNext, managing project form behaviors, including setup, loading, button actions, and related form operations.

methods.name: open_form
methods.description: Opens a quick entry form for a specified doctype and its child, pre-filling project details.

methods.name: set_buttons
methods.description: Configures custom buttons on the project form based on project state and user permissions.

methods.name: create_duplicate
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the current project with a new name provided by the user.

methods.name: set_status
methods.description: Sets the status of the project and associated tasks after user confirmation.
